structured_output.summary: Add the new primitives first (IfRange.check and header validation, then apply_conditions/apply_range), migrate send_file and then SharedDataMiddleware onto them, and only then deprecate make_conditional and the http helpers, since pytest treats warnings as errors. Docs and changelog come last. Tests that exercise the deprecated functions move or are removed in the deprecation task.

intents.rationale: No apply_conditions exists; make_conditional only handles GET/HEAD and returns 304/412 itself.
Range handling is private (_process_range_request) and driven by accept_ranges/complete_length args; a public apply_range is needed.
make_conditional, is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid are not deprecated yet.
make_content_range relies on is_byte_range_valid and does not clamp; from_header validation and ETagSet unquoted-value handling need review/tightening.
send_file uses make_conditional, hashes the path into the ETag, and raises TypeError without a name.
SharedDataMiddleware has its own serving logic, default cache_timeout of 12h, and non-deprecated cache/fallback_mimetype.
Quickstart still refers to make_conditional and CHANGES has no entry.
Tests exist only for make_conditional/is_resource_modified; new tests needed and old ones moved.

criteria.text: IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) is true for a strong ETag equal to etag or a date equal to last_modified, false otherwise (including empty IfRange, mismatched values).

Range.make_content_range clamps too-large stop and suffix values to the length, uses only the first range, and returns None for unsatisfiable ranges without using http.is_byte_range_valid; Range.from_header and ContentRange.from_header reject invalid values.
apply_conditions evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order for all methods, and sets Accept-Ranges: bytes.
Failed preconditions raise PreconditionFailed; a satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since on GET/HEAD yields 304 with entity headers removed.
A star ETag in If-Match/If-None-Match is evaluated according to the exists argument (exists True/False give different outcomes).
apply_range always sets Accept-Ranges: bytes, and leaves the response unchanged (no 206/416) for non-GET methods, non-200 status, or unknown/zero Content-Length, and for non-bytes units.

apply_range uses only the first range, clamps too-large stop/suffix, raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable when unsatisfiable, and otherwise produces 206 with sliced data, correct Content-Length and Content-Range.
With If-Range, apply_range applies the range only when the ETag (strong comparison) or Last-Modified matches the response.
send_file detects name, size and mtime from file-like objects when possible, calls seek(0) on file-like objects so range responses have correct lengths and an already-read file is sent in full.
send_file's generated ETag does not include a hash of the path.
send_file defaults to application/octet-stream when no download_name or mimetype is available instead of raising TypeError; conditional and range requests go through apply_conditions/apply_range.
SharedDataMiddleware serves files via send_file (conditional 304 and range requests work) and no longer sets cache_timeout by default.
Passing cache or fallback_mimetype to SharedDataMiddleware is still accepted but emits DeprecationWarning.
Response.make_conditional emits DeprecationWarning and still works, implemented via apply_conditions and apply_range.
werkzeug.http.is_resource_modified and is_byte_range_valid emit DeprecationWarning and still return the same results.
docs/quickstart.rst documents apply_conditions and apply_range instead of make_conditional, and CHANGES.rst has an entry for the new methods and deprecations.
Tests for the deprecated functions are moved or removed, and the whole suite passes with pytest -m 'not dev_server'.

tasks.summary: Add IfRange.check, make Range.make_content_range self-validating with clamping and first-range-only (no is_byte_range_valid), tighten Range/ContentRange.from_header validation and ETagSet.from_header invalid unquoted values.
Add Response.apply_conditions and Response.apply_range (using IfRange.check) alongside the existing, still non-deprecated make_conditional, and add tests for them.
Refactor send_file onto apply_conditions/apply_range: detect name/size/mtime from file objects, seek(0), drop path hash from ETag, default to octet-stream; update send_file tests.
Serve files in SharedDataMiddleware through send_file, drop the default cache_timeout, deprecate cache and fallback_mimetype params; update middleware tests.

Deprecate Response.make_conditional (reimplemented via the new methods) and http.is_resource_modified/is_byte_range_valid; migrate remaining internal callers and move/remove their old tests (expect DeprecationWarning where kept).
Document apply_conditions/apply_range in the quickstart and add a changelog entry covering new methods, deprecations and send_file/SharedDataMiddleware changes.
